lines.text: Thank you for seeing me. I'm sorry, I don't really know where to start. My husband, Paul, died six weeks ago.
He always dealt with the money. The mortgage, the bills... and now the letters keep coming and I can't even open them.
I keep thinking I'll have to sell the house. We bought it together thirty years ago. The children grew up there.
I don't even know what I'm allowed to ask. Are we behind? Is it too late to do anything? I honestly don't know.
I'm sorry. I didn't want to cry in front of you.
Thank you for listening. I think I just needed someone to say it's alright not to have all the answers yet.
